name: fred_ppi
description:
The US Producer Price Index, all commodities from FRED, the St. Louis Fed's economic database: series PPIACO (index 1982=100, monthly).
Returns {"series": "PPIACO", "data": <FRED observations response>}; data.observations = [{date (YYYY-MM-DD), value (a string, "." if missing), realtime_start, realtime_end}], newest first; data is {"error": ...} if the call fails.
Inputs (* required): series_id (string; default PPIACO, this tool's series), limit (integer, number of newest observations; default 20).
Related: fred_cpi, fred_core_cpi.
Example: {"series_id": "PPIACO", "limit": 20}

series_id.description: FRED series id; defaults to this tool's series

limit.description: Number of most recent observations to return (newest first)

data.description: FRED's series/observations response; {"error": ...} when the call fails

value.description: The observation's value as text ("." when FRED has none)
